messages:
alex: Quick sync — scheduled prod push tonight 22:00 UTC (10pm PDT) for v1.8.3. Who's pressing? Oncall (jamal) marked PTO after 21:00.

maria: I thought Jamal was taking it but saw his OOO. I can press if someone grants me deploy role or approves JIT.

jamal: Sorry y'all, PTO today. I set a pin on infra/service-config -> release_version = v1.8.3 to avoid accidental roll-forward.

tori: Note — pin is at infra/service-config:release_version=v1.8.3. If rollback needed, whoever presses must remove the pin first or the deploy will skip.

sre-oncall: I can press but need escalated MFA exemption? Our deploy flow requires presence in 'prod-deployers' group + MFA. Who can grant temporary access?

alex: We shouldn't change groups tonight. Alternative: use short-lived approver token via deploy-bot. @deploy-bot can do a one-time grant if @maria is approved by an approver list.

maria: I'm +1 to press. @alex can you confirm approver? I'll wait on the token.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Request received: temporary-deploy-token for user maria. Approver required: any member of [alex, jamal, tori]. Reply 'approve' to confirm.

tori: approve — Maria can press. Only constraint: do not unpin until rollback decision documented in release notes.

alex: approve. Maria — you have the token for 30m starting now. Please paste the release notes link and run the canary job.

maria: Got token, starting canary now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started for v1.8.3 (canary-id: c-72ab). 5% traffic. Monitor https://infra/redwood/canaries/c-72ab

jamal: quick reminder — if canary shows errors we roll back by applying deploy rollback script: `./scripts/rollback.sh --to-tag v1.8.2` — but remember to re-pin v1.8.2 if needed.

sre-oncall: Watching logs. Alert policy will auto-scale and notify if error-rate > 1.5%.

maria: Canary looks clean at 10m. Proceeding to gradual roll to 50%.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary update: 10m OK -> promoted to 50%.

tori: Documented rollback owner: jamal (on-call) — but since he's PTO, jamal delegates rollback to alex for tonight. Jamal, can you confirm delegation in this thread?

jamal: Confirm delegate: alex has rollback authority for this window (10:00-11:00 PDT). I'll reclaim when back.

alex: Acknowledged. If we need to rollback, I'll run the script and re-pin the previous tag.

maria: Full rollout at 70% now, release notes: https://docs.internal/releases/v1.8.3 — includes pin entry and rollback steps.

sre-oncall: No anomalies. ETA full rollout 20m.

maria: Full rollout complete. Closing token.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Temporary-deploy-token expired for user maria.

alex: Great. Action items: jamal to restore pin ownership tomorrow; tori to add the pin/unpin runbook to release notes. Thanks everyone :tada:
